title: selysia prunifera
intro: Selysia prunifera, commonly known as the Prune Tree or Selysia Prune Tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Selysiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of various gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Selysia prunifera are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to have a soothing effect on the digestive system. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
